dedupe_keys.name: land use land cover classifications of the play based regulation pilot study area derived from 2005 landsat imagery image data tiff format

description: Alberta Geological Survey provides a linked regional series of Landsat-derived land-use/land-cover classifications, annual disturbance and vegetation-recovery classifications, quality masks and compiled anthropogenic-footprint polygons for the Play-Based Regulation pilot area. The pilot coverage extends from Township 52, Range 7 west of the Fifth Meridian to Township 70, Range 5 west of the Sixth Meridian, including Edson, Fox Creek, Mayerthorpe, Whitecourt, Swan Hills and Valleyview. Nine annual classification titles span 2005–2013; eight disturbance and eight recovery pairs span 2005–2006 through 2012–2013. Seven quality-mask titles cover 2005–2011 and mark possible sensor-noise, cloud, haze or shadow misclassification with value 1. A companion shapefile compiles developed and mixed-developed footprint classes from the 2005–2013 classifications. The source explicitly defines these data as baselines for planning and monitoring surface infrastructure needs and impacts. The pilot was intended to coordinate surface development and reduce facility numbers and impacts. Descriptions for the 2007–2013 land-cover titles repeat a 2005 imagery year; the conflict is unresolved. Disturbance and recovery include oil/gas infrastructure effects alongside forestry and agriculture; they are not inventories of energy assets alone. TIFF-labelled products are linked as ZIP archives, and the footprint product is described as polygon GIS data. Only HTML/XML metadata routes are listed for the compiled footprint, so its payload route remains unresolved. Numerical contents, projection, pixel size, accuracy and cross-year comparability were not checked. The source states Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, while the catalogue machine flag isopen is false. Those fields are preserved without assuming the machine flag overrides the named licence. Metadata was inspected; no archive, image or GIS payload was fetched. Present distribution access and cost remain unverified.
